spanish: Y será que vengan a la tierra que dará Jehová a ustedes como que habló, y guardarán este servicio.

findings.issue: «como que» maps the preposition plus relative in כאשר, but in current Spanish it can be heard as «as if» or a hedge rather than only the comparative «as» with the piel perfect.

notes: Person, number, and Jehová match the tokens; ustedes verbs remain 2pl address.
